Validator V1, the permanently failed validator V2, validator V3, validator V4, their audits, the candidate, and the formal full-run gate remain immutable.

Audit paths, version labels, audit prefixes, report prose, predecessor identity checks, and full authorization binding advance to validator V5 full-only.

Any change to Laurent or polynomial formulas, normalized full-matrix SVD residuals, rho/stable gates, unmatched-root safety gates, HDF5 layout, checkpoint identity, or manifest identity logic.
Any change to the 1e-8 rho/residual gates, 1e-12 formula gate, rho<1 stable rule, or prior-failure verdicts.
